state.name: day
state.description: The day of the week on base, 1 to 7. Advances at 06:00.

state.name: change
state.description: How far the body has changed. +2 per ration piece, +3 per pill swallowed, +3 per night the call is followed. Never shown as a bar: camera height, hands, breath and the Chart show it.

state.name: hunger
state.description: Hunger now. Rises through the day faster as change rises; a ration piece lowers it for an hour, bread lowers it for the night.

state.name: clarity
state.description: Fisk's clear mind. Falls with ration pieces, pills and nights in the call. Drives the four UI tiers.

state.name: strength
state.description: What the body can do: duties, climbing, carrying. 50 + 0.5 x change, minus 10 for each day under two ration pieces with no bread.

state.name: warmth
state.description: Reset to 100 at the start of each excursion. Drains outside and in the cold halls at (12 - change/10) per minute.

state.name: suspicion
state.description: How much the staff watch Fisk. Seen rule breaks +20, unseen +5, food left visible on the tray +5, failed duty +5, reporting Jax -20.

state.name: jax_trust
state.description: How much Jax trusts Fisk. Bread given, cover at the Tray, nights out together, truth told at the bunk.

state.name: pull.pell
state.description: The call's hold on Pell. +15 a night; -15 for each loaf Fisk gives him. The seated crew member with the highest pull is taken at 10:00.

state.name: pull.duarte
state.description: The call's hold on Duarte. Same rules as pull.pell.

state.name: pull.kimura
state.description: The call's hold on Kimura. Same rules as pull.pell.

state.name: pull.hollis
state.description: The call's hold on Hollis. Same rules as pull.pell.

state.name: pull.jax
state.description: The call's hold on Jax. +15 a night, more if he eats as Fisk does; capped at 49 before night 5.

state.name: nights_followed
state.description: Nights Fisk let the call lead him (the door choice 'Follow', or 'Stay' removed by the call).

state.name: nights_out
state.description: Nights Fisk left the room after 10:00 for any reason.

state.name: chairs_empty
state.description: Empty chairs at the rec-room table. Each one removes a suit from Short Rations.

state.name: bread_banked
state.description: Loaves of bread Fisk holds. Won at Short Rations or given at the cafeteria; eaten or given away.

state.name: pills_taken
state.description: Pills swallowed at the Tray. A cheeked pill does not count.

state.name: contraband_left
state.description: Chocolate squares left in Fisk's kit. Eating one breaks rule one.

state.name: duties_failed
state.description: Day duties Fisk was too weak, too slow or too absent to finish.

state.name: knows
state.description: What Fisk understands, rung by rung. Raised by the Chart and by discoveries that break an explanation on the List.

state.name: meals
state.description: Every meal. kind is ration, bread, contraband, staff or refused; pieces is how many ration pieces were eaten. A Tray with no piece eaten is logged as refused.

state.name: rules_broken
state.description: Every broken rule. rule is diet, curfew or base; seen is yes or no.

state.name: the_list
state.description: Fisk's list of wrong things, each with the explanation he chose, and the day a later discovery broke it.

state.name: taken
state.description: Who left at 10:00 each night, and how many loaves Fisk had given them.

state.name: jax_arrived
state.description: Jax has taken the empty chair (evening of day 2).

state.name: jax_fate
state.description: Where Jax is. taken: the call took him at 10:00. reported: Sam took him after Fisk reported his plan.

state.name: jax_plan_answer
state.description: Fisk's answer to Jax's plan on day 5.

state.name: sam_offer_made
state.description: Sam has offered Fisk a place on staff (day 6; only after a report and with suspicion under 60).

state.name: sam_offer_accepted
state.description: Fisk took Sam's key and the staff ration.

state.name: claw_marks_measured
state.description: Day 2 duty: Fisk measured the claw marks at 3.6 metres up the wall.

state.name: boots_found
state.description: Night 3: the first bunkmate's boots in the kennel shed, laces still tied.

state.name: mail_held
state.description: Day 3: the outgoing mail sack is stamped HOLD and has never left.

state.name: cold_from_below
state.description: Day 4: the boilers run hot; the cold comes up through the floor drains.

state.name: files_read
state.description: Night 4: the project's source file and transfer roster in the officers' wing.

state.name: adit_found
state.description: Night 5: the giant bare footprints lead into the old mine adit.

state.name: void_located
state.description: Floor Plan: the missing paces placed behind the infirmary cold store.

state.name: pens_seen
state.description: Night 6: the pens below the base, and the first bunkmate's list on the wall.

state.name: night7_choice
state.description: The last choice at the door on night 7.

state.name: followed_with
state.description: Who walks with Fisk when he follows the call on night 7.

state.name: windigo_met
state.description: Night 7: the figure at the corner and its line.

state.name: fence_crossed
state.description: Night 7: Fisk reached the tree line beyond the fence.

state.name: jax_fell
state.description: Night 7, fence: Jax stopped in the snow and Fisk went on.

state.name: cave_reached
state.description: Fisk was taken to the cave (followed the call, with Jax or alone; caught at the fence; or gassed in the bunk).
